cells.text: eSLM concept
Stable interpretation for SOP Lang research
Processing node
One typed responsibility. In SOP Lang this may be represented by a command or subcircuit with a stable contract rather than a vaguely named agent.
Strategy
One reviewed implementation of a responsibility. Several strategies can correspond to alternative commands or template implementations without becoming different cognitive “nodes”.
Coordination node
A bounded allocator that funds and compares candidate strategies. It is closer to a meta-command or privileged scheduler than to ordinary domain knowledge.
Authority gate
A verifier of an invariant that cannot be outvoted by confidence scores. Some gates may be privileged runtime operations even if their invocation is visible in SOP.
Immutable packet plus receipt
The cross-component boundary carrying values and evidence. SOP @ variables and ~ handles can provide the language-level identity, while receipts record execution-level facts.
Abstention and PARTIAL
First-class outcomes when proof or coverage is insufficient. The absence of an established answer is not converted into a fluent guess.
The distinction between confidence and truth
is especially important for alternative command
Compiled capability artefact
Role at fast runtime
SOP source or template
Human- and agent-readable canonical expression of the computation or reasoning pattern.
Applicability descriptor
Small indexable summary of required input types, goal types, domains, authority requirements, and other conditions used before loading the full circuit.
Command or backend binding
Reviewed implementation identity, including effect and determinism declarations where relevant.
Validation envelope
Benchmarks, regression cases, transfer tests, known limitations, and domain assumptions that constrain legitimate reuse.
Cost profile
Observed or conservatively estimated time, memory, external calls, and completeness behavior under named work profiles.
Trustworthy-AI property
Potential SOP contribution and limit
Validity and reliability

Typed commands, independent verifiers, explicit completion status, regression suites, and replayable receipts can make failures observable. They cannot correct a false source or an invalid scientific theory automatically.
Accountability and transparency

Every authoritative result can identify the circuit, knowledge generations, command versions, external proposals, and promotion decisions involved. Accountability still depends on organizational ownership and governance.
Explainability and interpretability
Def-use and provenance paths provide faithful structural explanations of which values produced a result. An opaque neural node remains opaque internally and must be labelled accordingly.
Security and resilience

Inert KB packages, trusted registries, declared effects, isolation of generated commands, and handle-level policies reduce attack surface. They do not eliminate vulnerabilities in command implementations or external dependencies.
Privacy

Values and handles can carry sensitivity labels and restrict which commands or execution locations may consume them. Strong privacy may additionally require MPC, TEEs, differential privacy, or other mechanisms.
Fairness and harmful bias
Circuits can make fairness tests and assumptions explicit, but fairness is not a syntactic property of SOP Lang and must be defined in context.
